issues.explanation: CI workflows are infrastructure unrelated to the entities task and should not be part of this change.
Custom current_entity middleware is only aliased and never registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it stops applying on Livewire updates.
Tenant authorization uses direct membershipFor checks in controllers, middleware and Dashboard mount instead of policies/gates and $this->authorize.
CurrentEntity exposes duplicate get() and entity() accessors plus unused id()/check() helpers.

conventions.evidence: #[Validate]+validate in app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:290, #[Locked] in Dashboard.php:394, $fillable, audit channel and docs sync follow conventions; but auth uses direct membershipFor (EntityController.php:137, EnsureCurrentEntity.php:243, Dashboard.php:399) not policies/gates, and no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:124, app/Http/Middleware/EnsureCurrentEntity.php:212, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:317 clear names, small focused methods, PHPDoc, consistent style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: migrations entities_slug_unique (change.diff:948) and owner_seq+entity_memberships_one_owner (change.diff:992-995); policies EntityPolicy.php:699-728 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:642; onboarding slug retry CreateEntity.php:317-344 with withTrashed uniqueSlug:351; HomeController.php:169, EnsureCurrentEntity.php:212, switcher.blade.php:1140-1147, routes/web.php:1222-1236, lang/ui.php switch_entity/onboarding texts

scope.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 and .github/workflows/tests.yml:1 add CI unrelated to entities; rest (models, policies, onboarding, middleware, switcher, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md) serves the task

security.evidence: validated name CreateEntity.php:290, {{ }} escaping in switcher.blade.php:1144, Fillable + explicit Owner role CreateEntity.php:329, membership 403 checks EntityController.php:137 and Dashboard.php:399; gap: no $this->authorize calls and no persistent Livewire middleware for current_entity

simplicity.evidence: reuses x-layouts::default-page, x-form-field/x-button, Eloquent reads in controllers; minor indirection: CurrentEntity.php:788 get() vs entity() duplicates plus id()/check()

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:1257, EntityOnboardingTest.php:1366-1441 (validation, slug increment, insert-collision retry, audit log), EntityPolicyTest.php:1482, EntityTenantTest.php:1570-1751 (home dispatch, middleware 403, pick forbidden session untouched, switcher markup, navbar, Dashboard foreign forbidden)

review.summary: Implements the full entities/memberships model, single-owner DB invariant, tenant session, onboarding, switcher and dashboard with strong tests. Needs changes: remove unrelated CI workflows and align authorization with conventions (policies/gates and persistent Livewire middleware).
